name: Sixgree
tagline: Your professional network as a galaxy. Find the bridges into other circles and trace warm paths. Data stays on your computer.

name: Sponskip
tagline: Skips the sponsor reads on YouTube, including the ones creators disguise. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Comsly
tagline: The AI that answers your phone, screens callers in your own voice, and makes the calls you'd rather avoid.

name: TRIAD
tagline: Plug a MIDI controller into the browser and it becomes three synths. Nothing to install.

name: Sky Dial
tagline: Spin the world. Whatever radio or TV station sits under the dial is on the air.

name: Distress
tagline: Live police, fire and 911 dispatch from public agency feeds, on one globe.
